caseName: United States v. Chas. Pfizer & Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. Chas. Pfizer & Co., Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 402 U. S. 942.] Motion of respondents for additional time for oral argument and for three counsel to argue denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart, Mr. Justice White, and Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
